# All Things Good

> A 501(c)(3) non-profit organization sharing uplifting stories and amplifying everyday kindness on social media. All Things Good reaches over five million people each month with positive, hope-filled content.

All Things Good was founded in 2019 by Andrew Fox (Founder & Chairman) and his daughter Julia Fox (Co-Founder) on Instagram. The mission is simple: fill the internet with stories that remind us how good people can be. The organization is a registered 501(c)(3) non-profit.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2019
- Founders: Andrew Fox, Julia Fox
- Status: 501(c)(3) non-profit foundation
- Audience: 494K+ Instagram followers, 5M+ monthly impressions
- Content focus: feel-good news, acts of kindness, community stories, uplifting moments
